title: Dexterous Manipulation
date_semantics: First public arXiv submission, or journal publication for non-arXiv work. Revision dates are not release dates.
coverage: Curated literature: 44 unique works from 47 supplied BibTeX records, 2 requested additions, and 12 retained complementary seed papers. Adjacent datasets, general methods, and hardware are labeled separately.

papers.title: Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
papers.tldr: A reinforcement-learning policy trained entirely in randomized simulation controls a physical Shadow Dexterous Hand to reorient objects using vision. Randomizing dynamics and appearance enables transfer without human demonstrations. Coordinated behaviors such as finger gaiting and exploiting gravity emerge from learning rather than being individually programmed.
papers.tldr_zh: 在物理参数与视觉外观随机化的仿真环境中训练强化学习策略，随后直接迁移到真实 Shadow Hand，利用视觉完成物体重定向。训练无需人工示范，手指换步、多指协调以及借助重力等行为自然出现，奠定了大规模仿真学习灵巧操作的重要路线。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Solving Rubik's Cube with a Robot Hand
papers.tldr: Automatic domain randomization progressively broadens simulated environments to train both control policies and visual state estimators for manipulating a real Rubik’s Cube. Memory-based policies adapt during execution, while the complete system combines learned hand control with a dedicated robot platform to carry out demanding sequences of cube rotations.
papers.tldr_zh: 通过自动域随机化逐步扩大仿真环境难度与多样性，联合增强手部控制和视觉状态估计的现实鲁棒性。带记忆的策略能够在执行中适应环境，配合专门搭建的机械手系统完成魔方翻转与转面等连续操作，展示复杂多阶段操作中的仿真迁移。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: In-Hand Object Rotation via Rapid Motor Adaptation
papers.tldr: A history of joint motion can reveal enough about an unfamiliar object to adapt in-hand rotation without observing it directly.
papers.tldr_zh: 仅凭本体感知历史在线适应物体属性，把在仿真圆柱体上训练的手内旋转策略直接迁移到多种真实物体。

papers.tldr: A single RGB camera makes human demonstrations accessible for learning dexterous skills, reducing the burden of collecting robot-hand data.

papers.tldr: Combining observed scene geometry with the robot’s own imagined point cloud provides a transferable representation for dexterous reinforcement learning.

papers.title: DexPBT: Scaling up Dexterous Manipulation for Hand-Arm Systems with Population Based Training
papers.tldr: DexPBT expands reinforcement-learning exploration through decentralized population-based training in GPU simulation. A population of policies learns demanding single-arm and dual-arm skills, including regrasping, throwing, and object reorientation. The contribution is a scalable training approach for simulated hand–arm systems, with stronger performance than conventional end-to-end training.
papers.tldr_zh: DexPBT 在 GPU 并行仿真中用去中心化种群训练扩大强化学习探索。多个策略协同搜索训练设置，学习单臂与双臂的重抓取、抛掷和物体重定向。重点在于提升高维手臂系统的探索能力与训练效果，论文展示的是仿真实验。
papers.evaluation: Simulation

papers.title: AnyTeleop: A General Vision-Based Dexterous Robot Arm-Hand Teleoperation System
papers.tldr: AnyTeleop provides a camera-based teleoperation pipeline that works across different robot arms, dexterous hands, simulators, and camera arrangements. Human hand and wrist motion guide coordinated robot control. Real-world comparisons and downstream imitation-learning experiments show that a general-purpose interface can remain effective while reducing dependence on hardware-specific teleoperation systems.
papers.tldr_zh: AnyTeleop 用摄像头捕捉人手与手腕动作，通过统一遥操作流程支持不同机械臂、灵巧手、仿真器和相机配置。系统减少对特定硬件组合的依赖，同时在真实遥操作与后续模仿学习实验中保持较好的任务表现，为跨平台采集操作数据提供接口。

papers.tldr: Kinesthetic demonstrations pair the desired motion with tactile feedback, allowing learned visuomotor policies and fingertip force control to handle contact-rich tasks.

papers.title: DexHiL: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model Post-Training in Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: DexHiL improves dexterous vision-language-action policies through coordinated human intervention over the robot arm and fingers. Its teleoperation interface enables immediate corrections, while intervention-aware sampling gives corrective segments greater weight during post-training. Real-robot experiments test whether this interactive refinement improves reliability beyond offline fine-tuning.
papers.tldr_zh: 将机械臂与多指手的人类即时纠正统一接入 VLA 后训练，并优先采样纠正片段，提升真实机器人复杂接触任务的执行可靠性。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: ManipTrans: Efficient Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation Transfer via Residual Learning
papers.tldr: ManipTrans transfers human bimanual demonstrations into simulated robot-hand skills in two stages: a general trajectory imitator learns hand motion, then an interaction-constrained residual module adapts each manipulation. The resulting DexManipNet dataset collects robot demonstrations for coordinated tasks, including pen capping and bottle unscrewing, to support subsequent policy learning.
papers.tldr_zh: 先预训练通用轨迹模仿器，再以交互约束微调残差模块，将人类双手演示转成仿真机器人技能，并构建支持笔帽扣合、瓶盖旋拧的 DexManipNet。
papers.evaluation: Simulation

papers.title: SPIDER: Scalable Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
papers.tldr: SPIDER treats kinematic human motion as task guidance and uses physics-based sampling to find dynamically feasible robot trajectories without policy optimization. It supports diverse hand and humanoid embodiments, augments demonstrations with new loads and contacts, and provides trajectories for direct robot execution or downstream policy learning.
papers.tldr_zh: 以人类运动提供任务结构，通过物理采样生成动态可行轨迹，无需逐任务优化策略；支持多种手型与人形机器人，并可扩增负载、接触条件或直接部署。

papers.title: UniDex: A Robot Foundation Suite for Universal Dexterous Hand Control from Egocentric Human Videos
papers.tldr: UniDex combines human-video-derived robot trajectories, a shared function-aligned actuator space, and a 3D vision-language-action policy. Human-assisted retargeting and hand-masked point clouds reduce embodiment and visual mismatches; a portable RGB-D capture setup adds demonstrations. The suite targets tool-use policies that transfer across dexterous hands while reducing robot-specific data collection.
papers.tldr_zh: 将第一视角人类视频重定向为多种灵巧手轨迹，以功能对齐动作空间训练 3D VLA；结合去人手点云及便携 RGB-D 采集支持跨手型工具操作。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: ConTrack: Constrained Hand Motion Tracking with Adaptive Trade-off Control
papers.tldr: ConTrack formulates object-motion tracking as a constraint, then uses remaining control capacity to preserve demonstrated hand motion and contact timing. An online dual-variable update balances task accuracy against motion fidelity, while reachable mid-trajectory resets stabilize long sequences. The resulting reinforcement-learning controller transfers human demonstrations to simulated and real dexterous hands.
papers.tldr_zh: 将物体轨迹跟踪作为约束，以在线对偶更新调节任务准确度与手部动作保真度，并复用可达中间状态稳定长序列学习，验证仿真与真机迁移。

papers.title: DexMachina: Functional Retargeting for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: DexMachina learns functional retargeting by matching object-state trajectories from human demonstrations during long-horizon bimanual manipulation. Virtual object controllers initially assist the task, then gradually weaken as the robot policy takes over under motion and contact guidance. Its simulation benchmark compares how different hand designs handle articulated-object tasks.
papers.tldr_zh: 以物体状态而非纯手部姿态为目标，让虚拟物体控制器逐渐减弱、机器人策略逐步接管，学习双手长时程关节物体操作，并用仿真基准比较手型能力。

papers.title: DexTrack: Towards Generalizable Neural Tracking Control for Dexterous Manipulation from Human References
papers.tldr: DexTrack builds a general neural controller from successful robot tracking demonstrations paired with human references. Reinforcement and imitation learning improve the controller, while controller-guided homotopy optimization solves difficult individual trajectories and expands the training set. This iterative data-generation loop supports diverse object interactions, with evaluations in simulation and on real hardware.
papers.tldr_zh: 将强化学习与模仿学习结合训练通用跟踪控制器，再以控制器引导同伦优化解决困难轨迹、扩充成功示范，循环提升人类动作参考的仿真及真机执行。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Dexplore: Scalable Neural Control for Dexterous Manipulation from Reference-Scoped Exploration
papers.tldr: Dexplore jointly learns retargeting and tracking from imperfect hand-object motion capture instead of separating them into successive stages. Adaptive spatial scopes turn demonstrations into soft reinforcement-learning guidance, allowing robot-specific solutions. A vision-based, skill-conditioned generative controller distills the learned behavior for object generalization and deployment on a real robot.
papers.tldr_zh: 以自适应空间范围把不精确动作捕捉转为软约束，在统一强化学习过程中联合重定向与跟踪，再蒸馏为视觉条件生成控制器用于真实机器人。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: DexSynRefine: Synthesizing and Refining Human-Object Interaction Motion for Physically Feasible Dexterous Robot Actions
papers.tldr: DexSynRefine first generates coupled hand-object trajectories from task-conditioned motion manifold flow primitives, then grounds them with task-space residual reinforcement learning. A history-based adaptation module infers missing contact dynamics from proprioception, compensating for the mismatch between kinematic human demonstrations and executable robot actions during real-world dexterous manipulation.
papers.tldr_zh: 先以运动流形流基元生成耦合人手—物体轨迹，再用任务空间残差强化学习落实物理执行，并从本体感知历史推断接触动力学以适应真机。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 从本体感知历史估计接触动力学，不据此归入使用触觉传感器的工作。

papers.title: HandX: Scaling Bimanual Motion and Interaction Generation
papers.tldr: HandX provides curated and newly captured human bimanual motion, fine-grained language annotations, and hand-focused evaluation metrics. Its annotation pipeline extracts contact and finger-motion features before language-model description, while diffusion and autoregressive baselines benchmark conditional motion generation. This is a human-motion resource relevant to dexterity research, rather than a demonstrated robot-control policy.
papers.tldr_zh: 整合并新增双手动作捕捉数据，以接触和手指运动特征辅助语言标注，评测扩散与自回归生成模型；属于人类动作资源，未据此声称机器人控制能力。
papers.evaluation: Dataset / benchmark
papers.notes_zh: 人类双手动作数据、标注及生成基准；不据此认定为已部署的机器人策略。

papers.title: In-Hand Manipulation of Articulated Tools with Dexterous Robot Hands with Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.tldr: A simulation-trained base policy gains a hardware-learned refinement module for manipulating articulated tools in hand. Cross-attention fuses whole-hand tactile and force-torque feedback with action intent, proprioception, and target articulation. The controller adapts to tool-specific friction and other poorly modeled mechanics while maintaining grasp stability and regulating contact forces.
papers.tldr_zh: 在仿真策略上加入真机示范学习的细化模块，以交叉注意力融合全手触觉、力矩、本体感知与动作意图，适应剪刀、钳子等关节工具并调节接触力。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: SimToolReal: An Object-Centric Policy for Zero-Shot Dexterous Tool Manipulation
papers.tldr: SimToolReal trains one object-centric reinforcement-learning policy to move procedurally generated tool-like objects toward arbitrary goal poses. This shared training objective avoids separate reward design and object-specific policies for each tool task. The learned policy transfers zero-shot to real everyday tools, including behaviors requiring reorientation, thin-object grasping, and forceful interactions.
papers.tldr_zh: 在程序生成的工具形状上训练统一物体位姿目标策略，减少逐任务奖励及物体建模设计，零样本迁移到真实工具的抓握、手内转动与施力操作。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: UniBYD: A Unified Framework for Learning Robotic Manipulation Across Embodiments Beyond Imitation of Human Demonstrations
papers.tldr: UniBYD uses a shared morphological representation to learn manipulation across robotic hand designs. An annealed PPO reward schedule moves from human-demonstration guidance toward robot-specific exploration, while a shadow engine limits early state drift. The accompanying UniManip benchmark evaluates cross-embodiment manipulation beyond literal reproduction of human hand motions.
papers.tldr_zh: 用统一形态表示连接不同手型，通过退火奖励的 PPO 从人类示范引导过渡到机器人自身探索，并以影子引擎抑制早期状态漂移，配套 UniManip 基准。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: DexCtrl: Towards Sim-to-Real Dexterity with Adaptive Controller Learning
papers.tldr: DexCtrl addresses sim-to-real errors caused by mismatched low-level controller dynamics. The policy jointly predicts actions and controller parameters from trajectory and controller histories, then adapts those parameters online. Exposing controller settings in the observation helps the policy account for force interactions across dexterous tasks with variable contact conditions.
papers.tldr_zh: 针对低层控制器动力学不匹配，联合学习动作与控制参数，利用轨迹和控制历史在线自适应调参，改善不同受力条件下的灵巧操作仿真到现实迁移。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 关注控制参数与受力交互；摘要未明确触觉传感器输入，未标注为触觉策略。

papers.title: BiDexGrasp: Coordinated Bimanual Dexterous Grasps across Object Geometries and Sizes
papers.tldr: BiDexGrasp pairs a large bimanual dexterous-grasp dataset with a model that coordinates both hands across object shapes and sizes. Region-based initialization and decoupled force-closure optimization generate training grasps; a coordination module and geometry-size adaptation guide prediction for unseen objects. Evaluation includes simulation and real-world grasping.
papers.tldr_zh: 用区域初始化与解耦力闭合优化合成双手抓取数据，再以双手协调模块和几何尺寸自适应生成模型预测未见物体的抓取，包含仿真与真机验证。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Manipulation via a Unified Hand Action Space
papers.tldr: UHAS represents hand actions as deformations of a canonical sphere, then maps them to each robot through cascade inverse kinematics. Reinforcement-learning policies trained in this shared action space perform in-hand cube reorientation across different hand kinematics, supporting transfer to unseen embodiments and adaptation with limited fine-tuning in simulation and real-world tests.
papers.tldr_zh: 将手部动作表示为标准球面变形，再以级联逆运动学映射到各手型；在共享动作空间训练强化学习策略，实现立方体手内重定向及跨形态迁移。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 列出的手型涵盖仿真与真机研究对象；MANO 是人手模型，不能视为机器人硬件。

papers.title: DeXtreme: Transfer of Agile In-hand Manipulation from Simulation to Reality
papers.tldr: DeXtreme couples a reinforcement-learning manipulation policy with a robust visual object-pose estimator, both trained to tolerate varied simulated conditions. On a real Allegro Hand, the system performs agile object reorientation using ordinary cameras, illustrating how perception robustness and simulation diversity jointly improve transfer to physical hardware.
papers.tldr_zh: DeXtreme 同时训练灵巧操作策略和视觉物体位姿估计器，通过丰富的仿真条件提升二者的鲁棒性。系统在真实 Allegro Hand 上依靠摄像头执行敏捷的物体重定向，说明可靠感知与训练环境多样性需要共同设计，才能实现有效的仿真到现实迁移。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Transferring Dexterous Manipulation from GPU Simulation to a Remote Real-World TriFinger
papers.tldr: This system learns to move a cube to target six-degree-of-freedom poses using a three-finger robot and GPU simulation. Representing object pose through keypoints improves policy observations and rewards. Combined with domain randomization, the learned policy transfers to a remote physical TriFinger, achieving 83% success in the reported evaluation.
papers.tldr_zh: 使用 GPU 仿真训练三指机器人，将立方体移动至指定的位置与姿态。方法以关键点表示物体位姿，同时用于策略观察和奖励，结合域随机化改善训练与迁移效果。策略部署到远程真实 TriFinger 系统，在论文设定的任务中取得 83% 成功率。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Towards Human-Level Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation with Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_basis: Provided BibTeX abstract; primary repository for hand platform
papers.tldr: Bi-DexHands provides a GPU-accelerated simulation benchmark for coordinated two-hand manipulation, spanning many tasks and objects. It compares single-agent, multi-agent, offline, multitask, and meta reinforcement learning. While individual skills can be learned, the benchmark exposes substantial limitations in learning multiple skills and adapting efficiently to new tasks.
papers.tldr_zh: Bi-DexHands 提供基于 Isaac Gym 的双手灵巧操作仿真基准，覆盖多种任务与大量物体，并比较单智能体、多智能体、离线、多任务和元强化学习。实验显示单项技能可以有效学习，但技能复用、多任务掌握及少样本适应仍存在明显困难。
papers.evaluation: Dataset / benchmark
papers.notes_zh: 双手操作仿真基准；文中与儿童年龄的类比不代表机器人具备同等通用智能。

papers.title: DexGraspVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework Towards General Dexterous Grasping
papers.summary_basis: Provided BibTeX abstract; primary project page for proprioceptive observations
papers.tldr: DexGraspVLA combines a pretrained vision-language planner with an imitation-trained diffusion action controller for language-guided dexterous grasping. Foundation-model features reduce visual and language variation before control. The system generalizes across cluttered scenes and supports multistep instructions, recovery, and nonprehensile preparation, reporting over 90% grasping success on its unseen-scene evaluation.
papers.tldr_zh: DexGraspVLA 将预训练视觉语言规划器与扩散动作控制器结合，通过基础模型把变化的语言和视觉输入转换为较稳定的表示，再用模仿学习训练抓取。系统支持杂乱场景、长指令、失败恢复及非抓取式预调整，在论文未见场景测试中报告超过 90% 的抓取成功率。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Object-Centric Dexterous Manipulation from Human Motion Data
papers.summary_basis: Provided BibTeX abstract; primary project page for hardware and cross-hand evaluation
papers.tldr: A hierarchical framework transfers human manipulation structure into robot control by generating wrist trajectories conditioned on desired object states. A low-level reinforcement-learning controller then learns robot-specific finger interactions. Evaluation across household objects and real bimanual hardware shows generalization to new geometries and goals while separating motion priors from contact execution.
papers.tldr_zh: 将人类手部动作中的结构拆分为高层腕部轨迹与低层手指控制：生成模型根据物体目标状态产生腕部参考，强化学习负责适配机器人形态并实现接触交互。方法在多种日常物体上测试，并迁移至真实双手系统，兼顾人体动作先验与机器人可执行性。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Sequential Dexterity: Chaining Dexterous Policies for Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.summary_basis: Provided BibTeX abstract and primary project page, including real-world insertion limitation
papers.tldr: Sequential Dexterity connects separately learned manipulation skills through a transition-feasibility function that fine-tunes neighboring policies and selects suitable skills during execution. This improves long-horizon chaining and failure recovery, with zero-shot real-robot transfer. The project’s physical block-assembly demonstration still uses a scripted final pressing motion rather than fully learned insertion.
papers.tldr_zh: 通过转移可行性函数连接多个强化学习子策略，既微调技能间的衔接，也在执行时决定切换与失败恢复。方法提升长时序任务成功率并实现零样本现实迁移。其真实积木演示中最后向下压合由脚本完成，应区分已学习的策略衔接与完整自主装配。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 真实积木实验最后的下压插入由脚本完成，策略学习结果不应解读为全流程自主装配。

papers.title: Dynamic Handover: Throw and Catch with Bimanual Hands
papers.tldr: Dynamic Handover trains two arm–hand systems to throw and catch objects through multi-agent reinforcement learning in simulation. A learned object-trajectory predictor helps the catching hand react to the incoming object. The transferred system demonstrates coordinated dynamic manipulation of several real objects, with improved performance over the evaluated baselines.
papers.tldr_zh: Dynamic Handover 用多智能体强化学习协调两套手臂系统完成抛掷与接取。为降低仿真到现实差距，加入物体轨迹预测模型，使接取端根据飞行趋势实时调整动作。策略在仿真中训练，并迁移到真实机器人，对多种物体展示动态交接能力。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: RetrDex: Efficient Object Retrieval in Cluttered Scenes with a Dexterous Hand
papers.summary_basis: Provided BibTeX abstract and primary project page, including teacher-student training
papers.tldr: RetrDex learns to retrieve buried objects by treating pushing, stirring, and poking as parts of an integrated dexterous strategy. Parallel reinforcement learning uses spatial representations of occlusion and object relationships; a student policy learns from successful teacher trajectories. Evaluation includes varied clutter and zero-shot transfer to a real arm–hand system.
papers.tldr_zh: RetrDex 面向被杂物遮挡的目标检索，将推、拨、搅动等动作与抓取联合学习。策略通过空间关系表示理解遮挡，在并行仿真中训练教师，再从成功轨迹学习用于部署的学生策略。实验覆盖不同杂乱配置，并展示真实手臂系统的零样本迁移。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Closing the Reality Gap: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Deployment for Dexterous Force-Based Grasping and Manipulation
papers.tldr: This framework combines dense tactile observations with torque estimates derived from motor current to learn force-aware dexterous control. Fast tactile simulation, actuator calibration, and randomized nonideal dynamics support asymmetric actor–critic training. Policies transfer directly to a real five-finger hand for commanded grasp-force tracking and in-hand reorientation without hardware fine-tuning.
papers.tldr_zh: 将密集触觉观测与电流估计的关节力矩结合，用快速触觉仿真、电流力矩标定和非理想执行器建模缩小现实差距。非对称演员—评论家策略完全在仿真中训练，随后无需真机微调即可在五指手上跟踪抓握力指令并完成物体手内重定向。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: DexFlyWheel: A Scalable and Self-improving Data Generation Framework for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: DexFlyWheel grows demonstration datasets through repeated cycles of imitation learning, residual reinforcement learning, simulated rollout collection, and augmentation. Starting from seed demonstrations, each cycle broadens the situations covered by training data. The paper reports improved policy generalization and real-world dual-arm lifting after transfer through a digital-twin setup.
papers.tldr_zh: DexFlyWheel 从少量种子示范出发，循环执行模仿学习、残差强化学习、仿真轨迹收集与数据增强，使后续训练覆盖更多场景。该闭环利用已有策略持续生成和改进数据，论文展示了复杂任务泛化，以及借助数字孪生迁移后的真实双臂抬举效果。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Learning a Universal Human Prior for Dexterous Manipulation from Human Preference
papers.tldr: Human preferences over videos train a task-agnostic reward model that regularizes dexterous reinforcement-learning policies toward more human-like behavior. The method iteratively collects preferences across diverse policy rollouts, without requiring human demonstrations. Experiments on twenty simulated dual-hand tasks examine whether the learned prior transfers to tasks outside its training set.
papers.tldr_zh: 通过人类对机器人动作视频的偏好训练通用奖励模型，再用它约束强化学习策略，使动作更符合人的偏好。方法不需要人工动作示范，而是在多轮策略生成与反馈收集中学习先验，并在二十项仿真双手任务上检验行为改善及未见任务泛化。
papers.evaluation: Simulation
papers.notes_zh: 偏好来自人对视频的比较，非触觉反馈；实验覆盖仿真任务。

papers.title: Learning ambidextrous robot grasping policies
papers.summary_basis: Provided BibTeX abstract; author institution publication page for journal date
papers.tldr: Dex-Net 4.0 learns to select grasps across two heterogeneous end effectors: a parallel-jaw gripper and a suction cup. Training uses synthetic depth images and analytic grasp models with domain randomization. This adjacent grasping foundation demonstrates reliable bin clearing on a real robot, rather than multi-finger dexterous hand control.
papers.tldr_zh: Dex-Net 4.0 从大量合成深度图与解析抓取模型中学习，在平行夹爪和吸盘两种末端执行器之间选择合适抓取。域随机化帮助策略迁移至真实机器人，实现可靠的箱内取物。这里的双能抓取指异构夹具选择，因此作为相关基础收录，而非多指灵巧手控制。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 相关抓取基础：平行夹爪与吸盘的异构选择，并非多指灵巧手控制；日期为期刊发表日。

papers.title: DexPilot: Vision Based Teleoperation of Dexterous Robotic Hand-Arm System
papers.summary_basis: Provided BibTeX abstract and primary project page, including tactile-feedback limitation
papers.tldr: DexPilot maps camera observations of an operator’s bare hand to a high-dimensional robotic arm–hand system, providing low-cost dexterous teleoperation without a wearable input device. User experiments cover manipulation beyond simple pick-and-place, including in-hand adjustments and multistep tasks. The demonstrated interface relies on vision and does not return tactile feedback to operators.
papers.tldr_zh: DexPilot 从摄像头观察到的裸手动作控制高维机械臂与灵巧手系统，以较低成本完成无需手套的遥操作。不同操作者执行抓取、手内调整和多阶段任务，并可采集后续策略学习所需的状态动作数据。项目明确指出演示依靠视觉，未向操作者回传触觉。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 遥操作依靠视觉，项目明确未向操作者回传触觉；自主策略学习是其后续数据用途。

papers.title: DexYCB: A Benchmark for Capturing Hand Grasping of Objects
papers.tldr: DexYCB is a dataset and perception benchmark built from human hand–object interactions. It evaluates object and keypoint detection, object pose, hand pose, and safe grasp generation for human-to-robot handover. Its value for dexterous robotics is as a data and perception resource, rather than a demonstrated multi-finger robot control policy.
papers.tldr_zh: DexYCB 记录人手抓握物体的交互数据，评测目标与关键点检测、物体六维位姿、人手三维姿态，并研究人机交接中的安全抓取生成。它为灵巧操作提供感知基准和人体交互数据，作为相关数据基础收录，不等同于已部署的多指机器人操作策略。
papers.evaluation: Dataset / benchmark
papers.notes_zh: 相关数据与感知基础：主体是人手交互数据，不应视为多指机器人控制系统。

papers.title: Rethinking Policy Diversity in Ensemble Policy Gradient in Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: Regulates diversity in policy ensembles using KL constraints, seeking useful exploration without destabilizing large-scale reinforcement learning. Coupled Policy Optimization improves sample efficiency and final performance on multiple benchmarks, including dexterous manipulation. It is a general reinforcement-learning method rather than a manipulation-specific controller or tactile system.
papers.tldr_zh: 分析策略集成中多样性对探索效率的影响，通过策略间 KL 约束调节探索范围，避免过度分散破坏训练稳定性。方法在包括灵巧操作的多个任务上提升样本效率与最终表现；其贡献属于通用强化学习方法，作为相关基础工作收录。
papers.evaluation: Simulation
papers.notes_zh: 通用大规模强化学习策略集成方法，灵巧操作是评测任务之一，作为相邻的操作学习基础工作收录。

papers.title: Towards Learning to Play Piano with Dexterous Hands and Touch
papers.tldr: Trains dexterous hands to play a simulated piano directly from machine-readable scores using reinforcement learning. A curriculum and touch-augmented reward support learning key selection, rhythm, volume, and fingering. The study examines how tactile information and training choices affect this demanding temporally structured manipulation task.
papers.tldr_zh: 让灵巧手依据机器可读乐谱，在仿真钢琴上从零学习按键、节奏、力度与指法。课程学习和触觉增强奖励帮助探索，论文还比较触觉输入与训练设计的作用；实验使用带模拟 DIGIT 触觉传感器的 Allegro 手，尚属仿真验证。
papers.evaluation: Simulation
papers.notes_zh: 仅仿真验证。全文 III-A 的观测空间明确包括每根手指近期 DIGIT 触觉图及关节、腕部状态，因此触觉不仅用于奖励，也实际输入策略。使用 Allegro 手与 TACTO 模拟触觉传感器。

papers.title: Dexora: Open-source VLA for High-DoF Bimanual Dexterity
papers.tldr: Builds a vision-language-action system for dual-arm, dual-hand manipulation using hybrid exoskeleton and hand-tracking teleoperation. It combines embodiment-matched simulated trajectories with real demonstrations, then weights training clips by an offline quality discriminator when learning a diffusion-transformer policy. Experiments examine dexterity, distribution shifts, and transfer across embodiments.
papers.tldr_zh: 面向双臂双手高自由度操作，结合外骨骼背包和头显手部追踪采集遥操作数据，并配套仿真数字孪生。训练融合合成轨迹与真实示教，以离线判别器降低低质量片段权重，学习扩散 Transformer 策略，评估灵巧任务及跨构型泛化。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: DexImit: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
papers.tldr: Converts monocular human manipulation videos into physically plausible robot demonstrations through interaction reconstruction, subtask decomposition, bimanual scheduling, trajectory synthesis, and data augmentation. The pipeline draws on internet or generated videos and targets dexterous skills including tool use, extended task sequences, and fine manipulation, with zero-shot real-world deployment as its goal.
papers.tldr_zh: 从单目人类视频重建手物交互，再进行子任务分解、双手调度、机器人轨迹合成与数据增强，自动生成物理可行的机器人示教。输入可来自互联网或视频生成模型，面向切苹果、制作饮品与叠杯等任务，支持零样本真实部署。
papers.evaluation: Not specified
papers.notes_zh: 摘要描述零样本真实部署的数据生成路线，但未给出明确实机评估结果；evaluation 暂记 Not specified，待进一步核查实验部分。

papers.title: Towards Robotic Dexterous Hand Intelligence: A Survey
papers.tldr: Surveys robotic dexterous hands through hardware, sensing, control and learning, datasets, and evaluation practices. By connecting embodiment and sensing assumptions with methodological progress, the review highlights trade-offs in force capability, compliance, bandwidth, and integration, and identifies obstacles to comparing systems and advancing general dexterous manipulation.
papers.tldr_zh: 从硬件、感知、控制学习、数据与评估四方面梳理机器人灵巧手研究，讨论驱动与传动、力能力、柔顺性和系统集成的取舍。综述将方法演进与构型、传感配置及训练评测条件联系起来，帮助理解不同工作的可比性与未来挑战。
papers.evaluation: Survey

papers.title: DROP: Dexterous Reorientation via Online Planning
papers.tldr: Uses online sampling-based predictive control and visual object-pose estimation for in-hand cube reorientation. Rather than relying on a policy learned offline across many simulated contacts, DROP searches candidate control actions during execution. Real-world experiments examine controller design and robustness, finding performance comparable to previously reported reinforcement-learning approaches.
papers.tldr_zh: 将手内立方体重定向视为在线规划问题，用视觉估计物体位姿，再以采样式预测控制实时搜索接触动作。真实机器人实验分析架构选择和鲁棒性因素，表明这种无需预先训练操作策略的方案可达到与既有强化学习方法相近的表现。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 采用在线规划进行手内重定向；首次公开于 2024 年，Bib 中的 2025 年对应后续版本。

papers.title: Learning Dexterous Manipulation Using Contact Wrench Guidance From Human Demonstration
papers.tldr: Guides reinforcement learning with object-centered contact wrenches derived from human demonstrations, comparing motions through the forces and torques they induce. CHORD scales to long-horizon manipulation of rigid and articulated objects, introduces a large bimanual simulation benchmark, and transfers learned behaviors to real robots. Demonstration-derived wrench guidance does not establish runtime tactile sensing.
papers.tldr_zh: 以物体中心的接触力与力矩空间对齐人类和机器人动作，用诱导物体运动的相似性引导强化学习。方法覆盖刚体和关节物体的长时程双手操作，建立大规模仿真基准并展示真实迁移；示教中的力旋量指导不等于部署时使用触觉传感器。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 接触力旋量由人类示教引导强化学习；所提供摘要未确认真实执行阶段采用触觉传感器，不据此标记触觉反馈。

papers.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
papers.tldr: Treats articulated-tool manipulation as an animation problem, turning procedurally generated grasp keyframes into feasible trajectories through motion planning and reinforcement learning. Minimal manual affordance annotation drives the data-generation pipeline. Experiments on four articulated tools demonstrate zero-shot simulation-to-real transfer for grasping and in-hand manipulation across different scales and joint types.
papers.tldr_zh: 借鉴动画制作，把程序生成的抓取关键帧，经运动规划与强化学习转为操作轨迹。每件工具只需少量鼠标操作标注功能可供性，即可较自动地生成数据；在四种不同尺度与关节类型的工具上验证抓取和手内操作的零样本仿真迁移。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Towards Human-level Dexterous Teleoperation
papers.tldr: Learns a hand-object co-tracking controller that translates teleoperator intent into low-level contact execution. Subgoal and dense tracking rewards train a single-stage reinforcement-learning policy, while masking and domain randomization support zero-shot transfer. Across two hands, experiments cover reorientation and extended tool use; collected demonstrations also train autonomous behavior-cloning policies.
papers.tldr_zh: 将操作者意图转为手物协同跟踪子目标，再由强化学习控制器执行底层接触动作。稀疏目标与密集跟踪奖励结合，借助动作遮蔽和域随机化迁移至实机；两种灵巧手完成重定向及长时程工具操作，采集的示教还能训练自主策略。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: UniCross: Unified Cross-Skill Dexterous Manipulation Synthesis
papers.tldr: Unifies grasping, relocation, in-hand rotation, and in-hand translation within shared state and action spaces and a common objective structure. The formulation enables distillation into one policy that connects these skills into extended sequences, generalizes to unseen objects, tolerates disturbances, and transfers across different robotic hand morphologies.
papers.tldr_zh: 把抓取、搬移、手内旋转与手内平移四种技能统一到相同状态、动作空间和目标结构中，再蒸馏为单一跨技能策略。方法旨在解决独立技能难以衔接的问题，展示长时程组合、未知物体泛化、扰动鲁棒性，以及不同机器人手构型间迁移。
papers.evaluation: Not specified
papers.notes_zh: 所提供摘要未指明验证环境为仿真还是实机，因此 evaluation 暂记 Not specified。

papers.title: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: Combines slower vision-language action planning with asynchronous tactile action refinement using a variable-rate mixture of transformers and temporal tactile encoding. Trained with human-video pretraining and tactile robot demonstrations, T-Rex uses live fingertip force and deformation signals on bimanual Sharpa Wave hands for twelve real-world contact-sensitive manipulation tasks.
papers.tldr_zh: 以较慢的视觉语言动作规划搭配快速异步触觉修正，通过时序触觉编码和混合 Transformer 处理实时接触变化。结合人类视频预训练与触觉机器人示教，在双 Sharpa Wave 手上利用指尖力及形变信号，完成十二项真实接触敏感任务。
papers.evaluation: Real robot

papers.title: Morphometric Imitation: From Morphology and Contact Aware Hand Retargeting to Sim-to-Real Visuomotor Policy
papers.tldr: Preserves human hand-object contacts through morphology-aware retargeting, refines the resulting motion with residual reinforcement learning, and distills demonstrations into point-cloud visuomotor policies. Evaluation spans three hand designs, with zero-shot real deployment on Sharpa Wave. Contact information guides simulation training; the deployed policy uses vision and proprioception rather than tactile sensing.
papers.tldr_zh: 先通过形态与接触匹配重定向人手动作，再用残差强化学习生成物理可行的示教，最后蒸馏为点云视觉运动策略。方法比较三种手构型，并在 Sharpa Wave 上零样本部署；接触信息用于仿真训练，实机策略读取视觉和本体状态。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 接触状态是仿真残差强化学习教师的特权信息及奖励依据。部署学生策略仅以当前和前一帧点云、本体感知与上一动作命令为输入，不能归为运行时触觉反馈。三种手用于仿真比较；真实实验为 KUKA iiwa14 搭配 Sharpa Wave 和 RealSense L515。

papers.title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
papers.tldr: A temporal model fuses vision, proprioception, and fingertip touch to assess a grasp before lifting. On a four-fingered robot, its stability estimate gates lift-or-regrasp decisions. The work also collects 10,000 multimodal grasp trials across 200 objects and studies which tactile spatial and temporal cues aid prediction.
papers.tldr_zh: 融合视觉、本体状态与指尖触觉序列，在抬升前预测抓取稳定性，并在四指实机上据此选择抬升或重抓。工作采集覆盖 200 件物体的 10,000 次多模态抓取试验，分析触觉空间细节和时序信息对预测的作用。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 触觉用于执行时的抬升/重抓决策；不标记为强化学习、模仿学习或力控制。代码链接目前对应数据查看与重采样工具；完整训练/部署代码和数据下载可用性未独立确认。

papers.title: Dex-X: Learning Visual-Tactile Dexterous Manipulation From Human Videos with Simulated Interaction
papers.tldr: Dex-X reconstructs human demonstrations in simulation, learns a tactile-aware expert, and distills it into a point-cloud and fingertip-force policy. Evaluation covers six simulated task categories and four real tasks on a Sharpa Wave hand, including 28/30 cube picks and 16/30 squeegee trials without real-world fine-tuning.
papers.tldr_zh: 将人类视频重建为仿真交互，以触觉强化学习教师蒸馏点云与指尖力策略。在六类仿真任务和 Sharpa Wave 实机四项任务上评测；无需实机微调，方块抓取为 28/30，刮水器操作为 16/30。
papers.evaluation: Simulation and real robot
papers.notes_zh: 部署仍依赖重定向运动参考；触觉表示为每指尖的标量力幅值。

papers.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
papers.tldr: BORA couples an action-conditioned VLA critic with human corrections and online residual adaptation while freezing the base policy. Across six real-robot tasks on two hand platforms, 20 online trajectories per task raise standard-object success from 60.8% to 82.5%; the assisted twisting actor does not observe contact forces.
papers.tldr_zh: 将动作条件价值学习、人类纠错与冻结基座的在线残差适配结合。在两种灵巧手平台的六项实机任务上，每任务增加20条在线轨迹后，常规物体成功率由60.8%升至82.5%；辅助拧转策略不读取接触力。
papers.evaluation: Real robot; simulation-trained local twisting assistance
papers.notes_zh: 成功率增益同时包含新增在线数据与残差更新的影响，不能归因于残差算法单一因素；不添加Tactile feedback。

papers.title: Deformable In-Hand Slip-Aware Tactile Sensor with Integrated Velocity Sensing, Force/Torque and Pressure Map Estimation
papers.tldr: A deformable tactile module combines optical sliding-velocity measurements with magnetic force/torque and pressure-map estimation. Bench characterization and 100 closed-loop sliding trials on a custom parallel gripper demonstrate its relevance to in-hand manipulation; transparent surfaces and strong curvature limit tracking.
papers.tldr_zh: 柔性接触垫集成光学滑移速度测量与磁式力/力矩、压力图估计。在台架及定制平行夹爪的100次闭环滑动试验中验证手内操作用途；透明表面与较大曲率会限制跟踪。
papers.evaluation: Physical sensor characterization and custom parallel-gripper experiments
papers.notes_zh: 无多指灵巧手验证；闭环控制器沿用先前工作并重新调参，本文创新集中在传感器。

papers.title: DexHoldem: An Agentic Robotics Benchmark for Dexterous Manipulation in Texas Hold'em
papers.tldr: DexHoldem benchmarks real ShadowHand card and chip manipulation using 1,470 teleoperated demonstrations and 14 primitives. It separates primitive completion from scene preservation and tests perception and closed-loop decision routing. The best completion rate is 61.2%, while the best scene-preserving rate is 47.5%.
papers.tldr_zh: 以1,470条遥操作示教和14种原语评测 ShadowHand 扑克牌与筹码实机操作，分别衡量任务完成、场景保持、感知与闭环决策。最高完成率为61.2%，最高场景保持成功率为47.5%。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 项目页的部分感知分数和标题仍为旧表述；本记录的元数据、总结与评测依据arXiv v3，不沿用项目页旧分数。

papers.title: SoTa: Soft Tactile Skins for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: SoTa gives human and robot hands matching 202-taxel capacitive skins and a shared tactile encoder. Human demonstrations supervise task-phase representation learning, while robot demonstrations supervise actions. Three real-robot tasks test touch and co-training; the full method raises mean success across eight conditions from 22.8% to 45.9%.
papers.tldr_zh: 为人手与机器人提供对应的202单元电容皮肤和共享触觉编码器。人类示教用于阶段表征监督，机器人示教用于动作学习；三项实机任务的八种条件下，完整联合训练使平均成功率由22.8%升至45.9%。
papers.evaluation: Real robot; human demonstrations for auxiliary training
papers.notes_zh: 每方法/任务仅一个训练种子；人类动作不参与动作损失，不能表述为直接人类动作克隆。

papers.title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.tldr: PointWAM jointly forecasts scene and hand trajectories in 3D, then retargets hand forecasts to robot commands. Human-video pretraining precedes robot-demonstration fine-tuning. It achieves 69.0% mean success on ten simulated DexJoCo tasks and is evaluated on two real OpenArm tasks using Inspire hands.
papers.tldr_zh: 联合预测场景与手的三维轨迹，再将手轨迹转换为机器人命令；先用人类视频预训练，再以机器人示教微调。在十项DexJoCo仿真任务上平均成功率69.0%，另在搭载Inspire手的OpenArm上评测两项实机任务。
papers.evaluation: Simulation and real robot; human-video pretraining
papers.notes_zh: 不添加Model-based planning或Tactile feedback：使用轨迹预测与重定向，无独立规划器，也未以真实触觉作为策略输入。

papers.title: DexJoCo-X: Benchmarking Action Representations for Multi-Hand Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: DexJoCo-X standardizes six simulated tasks across seven hand morphologies with 2,100 demonstrations. It compares native coordinates, functional slots, and learned action latents under matched protocols. A jointly trained Being-H0.5 policy reaches 47.7% with functional slots versus 47.0% with native coordinates; physical-robot evaluation remains future work.
papers.tldr_zh: 在七种手型、六项仿真任务和2,100条示教上统一比较动作表征。联合训练Being-H0.5时，功能槽与原生坐标平均成功率分别为47.7%与47.0%；实机评测仍列为未来工作。
method: Native, FAAS and DexLatent action representations
papers.evaluation: Simulation
papers.notes_zh: 多手表示对比并不证明对未见手的零样本迁移；项目页代码与数据仍显示准备发布，未添加下载或代码链接。

papers.title: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
papers.tldr: GOTT separates reaching, contact acquisition, and object-motion tracking. A shared reinforcement-learning primitive uses local hand–object geometry and proprioceptive history across hand designs. Simulation evaluates grasp transfer, while real XHand and Sharpa systems test lifting and downstream manipulation; contact switching is inferred from proprioception.
papers.tldr_zh: GOTT 将靠近、接触建立和物体轨迹跟踪分阶段执行，以局部手物几何和本体历史训练跨手构型的强化学习原语。仿真检验抓取迁移，实机 XHand 与 Sharpa 系统检验抬升及后续操作；接触切换由本体感知预测。
papers.evaluation: Simulation and real robot
papers.notes_zh: Allegro及变体用于仿真；实机平台为Franka-Sharpa、Franka-XHand、Tianji-XHand。项目网页未能打开，未保留项目或代码链接。

papers.title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
papers.tldr: DexAgent converts a human video into robot training data through object-aware reconstruction, verified trajectory generation, and simulation augmentation. Its reusable skill library supports varied object types and task sequences. Evaluation separates human-data reconstruction and simulated trajectory checks from bimanual Sharpa replay and learned-policy tests on eleven real tasks.
papers.tldr_zh: DexAgent 通过物体属性重建、轨迹生成与验证、仿真增强，将单个人类视频转成机器人训练数据，可复用工具库支持不同物体和任务序列。评测分别覆盖人体数据重建、仿真轨迹检查，以及双 Sharpa 实机的11项轨迹回放与学习策略任务。
papers.evaluation: Human datasets, simulation, and real robot
papers.notes_zh: 原文的11/11是回放至少一次成功的任务数，不是闭环策略成功率；闭环平均成功率为63.6%。摘要和Comments给出两个不同项目地址，均未成功打开，因此不加入链接。

papers.title: TacOT: Learning Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Tactile-Guided Optimal Transport
papers.tldr: TacOT matches human and robot demonstrations using action–tactile temporal alignment and optimal transport while training a multimodal flow policy. The deployed XHand policy reads current RGB, hand state, and fingertip forces; alignment is training-only. Four real tasks assess in-distribution performance and transfer to conditions present only in human demonstrations.
papers.tldr_zh: TacOT 用动作与触觉时序匹配及最优传输对齐人机示教，联合训练多模态流策略。部署 XHand 策略读取当前图像、手状态和指尖力，对齐仅用于训练。四项实机任务检验域内表现及向仅在人类示教出现条件的迁移。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 人类Paxini力传感与机器人XHand内置触觉分别采集；域外设置相对机器人训练域定义，已包含在人类示教中，不代表完全未见场景。

papers.title: AgenticTactileVLA: Contact-Guided Execution-Time Supervision for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation without VLA Retraining
papers.tldr: An execution supervisor checks and corrects finger closure around a fixed VLA, retaining accepted grasps or returning control for retries. It uses finger positions and motor-effort proxies, with an optional compliant mode. Tests on a G1 with a Revo2 hand cover five held-out objects; fragile-object tests cover closure and holding only.
papers.tldr_zh: 执行监督器围绕固定 VLA 检查并修正手指闭合，保留可接受抓取或交还控制权重试，依据为手指位置与电机负载代理，并可选择柔顺模式。G1 配 Revo2 手检验五种留出物体；易损物体测试仅涵盖闭合与保持。
papers.evaluation: Real robot
papers.notes_zh: 不使用额外触觉硬件；motor-effort不等于标定接触力。依赖可行的VLA接近策略，未验证从任意接近错误恢复。

papers.title: PatternDex: Learning Interaction Patterns to Guide Reinforcement Learning of Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Objects
papers.tldr: PatternDex learns interaction tokens from human object–wrist motion and decodes robot-specific wrist and contact guidance for reinforcement learning. ARCTIC demonstrations support simulated bimanual evaluation across four hand designs. A separate Allegro–xArm6 experiment tests microwave opening on hardware; predicted contacts guide learning rather than provide tactile sensing.
papers.tldr_zh: PatternDex 从人体物体—手腕运动学习交互token，解码适合目标机器人的腕部与接触指导，再训练强化学习策略。ARCTIC示教用于四种手的仿真双手评测，另以 Allegro–xArm6 实机测试开微波炉；预测接触用于指导学习，不是触觉测量。
papers.evaluation: Human dataset, simulation, and real robot
papers.notes_zh: Shadow、Paxini、XHand跨构型结果来自仿真；实机仅报告开微波炉。接触奖励和预测接触点不构成运行时触觉传感。项目页未能打开，未保留链接。

papers.title: Now You Feel It, Now You See Me: Digital-Twin-based Teleoperation Interface for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: A digital-twin AR interface supports bare-hand teleoperation of two dexterous hands by displaying fingertip forces and revealing occluded grasp regions. Hardware user studies compare force displays and visual assistance during cup relocation and box lifting. The tactile signals inform human operators; autonomous policy learning or tactile-conditioned robot control is not evaluated.
papers.tldr_zh: 数字孪生 AR 界面将指尖力可视化并显示被遮挡的抓取区域，支持双灵巧手裸手遥操作。实机用户研究比较纸杯搬运与箱体抬升中的力显示和视觉辅助。触觉用于帮助操作者判断，未评测自主策略学习或触觉条件机器人控制。
sensing: Tactile measurements visualized to the operator
papers.evaluation: Real-robot teleoperation user study
papers.notes_zh: 触觉显示进入人类操作者反馈回路，未声称有自主触觉策略；未添加Tactile feedback标签。未报告下游策略学习收益。

papers.title: VICON: Visual-Inertial-Contact based Hand-Object Tracking for Manipulation Datasets
papers.tldr: VICON combines RGB-D, glove inertial tracking and measured human contact to refine hand–object trajectories under occlusion. Evaluation uses human manipulation recordings, including 40 motion-capture sessions over five rigid objects; robot policy learning remains future work.
papers.tldr_zh: 融合 RGB-D、惯性手套和人类接触测量，以因子图修正遮挡下的手物轨迹。在五种刚性物体的 40 段动捕序列上评测追踪；机器人策略学习仍属后续工作。
papers.evaluation: Human manipulation recordings; 40 motion-capture sessions within 71 recorded sessions; no robot policy evaluation
papers.notes_zh: FSR接触测量来自人类采集手套，未评测机器人策略；官方仓库目前只有说明，完整数据仍待发布。

papers.title: FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting
papers.tldr: A shared off-policy tracking policy retargets many human hand–object demonstrations using geometric interaction rewards and separate hand-wise actor–critics. Tests cover 50 motions on two simulated hands, scaling to 1,000 references and physical trajectory replay; deployment still depends on privileged simulation states.
papers.tldr_zh: 共享离策略跟踪策略结合几何交互奖励和左右手独立 actor–critic，批量重定向人类示教。评测涵盖两种仿真手、50 段动作、千段扩展及实机轨迹回放，未实现实机观测闭环策略。
sensing: Privileged simulated robot and object states
papers.evaluation: Isaac Sim benchmark and scaling study; physical XHand trajectory replay
papers.notes_zh: 真实硬件只回放仿真产生的轨迹；策略依赖特权仿真状态，不能据此声称已实现实机观测闭环迁移。

papers.title: Mask2Real-WM: Controllable Dexterous World Models via Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge
papers.tldr: Mask2Real-WM separates action-conditioned mask dynamics from RGB rendering, using simulation to broaden motion coverage and 2.5 hours of real demonstrations for adaptation. On an ORCA-hand setup, blind video ratings and prediction metrics assess command following; downstream control success is not evaluated.
papers.tldr_zh: 将动作条件掩码动力学与 RGB 渲染分开，用仿真扩展动作覆盖，再以 2.5 小时真实示教适配。在 ORCA 手平台数据上盲评视频动作响应及预测质量，尚未评估下游控制成功率。
papers.evaluation: Simulation and real robot datasets; generated-video controllability and perceptual metrics
papers.notes_zh: 评测的是动作条件视频生成与感知质量，尚未报告利用该世界模型的规划或闭环策略成功率。

papers.title: DEXTERA: From a Single Image to Deployable Dexterous Manipulation via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
papers.tldr: DEXTERA combines single-image asset reconstruction with additional metric calibration, task primitives and synthesized demonstrations for dexterous policy learning. Evaluation separates trajectory replay from closed-loop policies across 13 task–embodiment pairs on two physical platforms, with additional simulation–real co-training comparisons.
papers.tldr_zh: 由单图生成资产，结合额外度量标定、任务原语和合成示教训练灵巧策略。在两套实机的 13 个任务—平台组合上分别验证轨迹回放与闭环策略，并比较仿真和真实数据混合训练。
papers.evaluation: Scene reconstruction, physical trajectory replay, and separate simulation/real closed-loop policy evaluations
papers.notes_zh: 87.95%对应筛选后轨迹的实机回放，不是闭环策略成功率；单图资产生成仍需额外度量标定。项目代码标为待发布。

papers.title: DITTO-X: Forward and Reverse Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation and Human Intervention
papers.tldr: DITTO-X retargets forward teleoperation across three dexterous hands and actuates the operator’s fingers to match the robot before intervention. Force/contact feedback supports demonstration collection and DAgger; evaluation includes six users and real manipulation policies, with runtime tactile observations on Sharpa.
papers.tldr_zh: 跨三种灵巧手映射正向遥操作，并在接管前驱动操作者手指匹配机器人。力与接触反馈支持示教和 DAgger；通过六人研究及实机策略评测，Sharpa 条件下策略执行读取触觉。
sensing: Hand joint angles and end-effector pose
Motor-current or force estimates for operator feedback
papers.evaluation: Six-person user study; physical manipulation and policy refinement on three hand embodiments
papers.notes_zh: 执行时触觉标签仅对应Sharpa配置；Wuji 2与Inspire的电流/力估计反馈不能等同于该触觉传感配置。

papers.title: EgoSteer: An Open-Source Full-Stack System Towards Steerable Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
papers.tldr: EgoSteer combines egocentric human-video pretraining, robot demonstrations and DAgger with a flow-based VLA and a training-only world-model objective. Physical evaluation covers 45 instruction-following tasks and few-shot adaptation to five long-horizon tasks on two platforms using Ruiyan dexterous hands.
papers.tldr_zh: 以人类第一视角视频预训练，结合机器人示教、DAgger、流式 VLA 和仅训练期使用的世界模型目标。在 Ruiyan 灵巧手实机上评测 45 个指令任务，并在两平台验证五个长程任务的少样本适配。
sensing: Wrist pose and fingertip state history
papers.evaluation: Human-video corpus curation; real robot evaluation on RealMan and AgiBot G1 platforms
papers.notes_zh: 世界模型分支仅用于训练，推理时移除；深度不进入部署策略。项目页面未能核验，因此未添加项目或代码链接。

papers.title: DexForge: High-Fidelity Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
papers.tldr: DexForge turns human video into robot trajectories through contact-constrained retargeting and differentiable dynamics. Evaluation covers seven simulated hands, simulator transfer, and open-loop object interaction on a G1 with LEAP Hand v1.
papers.tldr_zh: 以接触约束重定向和可微动力学优化，将人类视频转成机器人轨迹。评测覆盖七种仿真手、跨仿真器迁移及G1搭载LEAP Hand v1的物体交互开环回放。
sensing: Motion capture for torso compensation during replay
papers.evaluation: Simulation on seven hand embodiments; sim-to-sim transfer; 50 real-robot open-loop grasp-and-hold trials
papers.notes_zh: 手型字段列已核验的实机手。真实实验不以物体反馈更新动作，成功标准为稳定抓持5秒；无运行时触觉依据。代码链接为重定向部分。

papers.title: MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation
papers.tldr: MobileVISTA augments demonstrations with jointly synthesized egocentric views and retargeted actions to improve base-pose robustness. Evaluation includes dexterous-hand tasks in simulation and real R1 Pro gripper manipulation; the real experiments do not establish multi-finger deployment.
papers.tldr_zh: 联合生成第一视角图像与重定向动作示教，提高底座位姿变化下的策略鲁棒性。评测包含多指灵巧手仿真及R1 Pro夹爪实机操作，实机结果不代表多指部署。
task: Book stacking and laundry sorting with real grippers
papers.evaluation: DexMimicGen dexterous-hand simulation tasks; real Galaxea R1 Pro gripper evaluation on book stacking and laundry sorting
papers.notes_zh: 多指关联由正文采用的环境定义与DexMimicGen官方说明交叉确认；未核验具体手型号，因此hand留空。实机是夹爪。项目页无法打开，未添加项目或代码链接；DexMimicGen链接仅为环境依据。

papers.title: ReDex: Repairing Sim-to-Real Dexterous Policies by Finger-Level Compliant Interaction
papers.tldr: ReDex learns from finger-level physical corrections of a simulation policy, then deploys a standalone behavior-cloning policy conditioned on joint and tactile-force histories. Real XHAND1 tests cover object flipping and screwdriver rotation, with object-specific adaptation.
papers.tldr_zh: 在仿真策略执行时通过单指柔顺引导纠错，再训练读取关节及触觉力历史的独立行为克隆策略。XHAND1实机验证物体翻转和螺丝刀旋转，适配策略按物体分别训练。
sensing: Fingertip net three-axis force from magnetic tactile arrays
papers.evaluation: Autonomous real-robot evaluation on five objects, 25 trials per object–method pair
papers.notes_zh: 翻转报告成功率；螺丝刀报告旋转进度，不将进度等同成功率。基础策略仅本体感知，触觉反馈加入最终实机策略。

papers.title: EigenDEXplore: Structured Exploration for Dexterous Manipulation with Human Priors
papers.tldr: EigenDEXplore adds human-derived correlated noise during policy and trajectory search while retaining full joint-space actions. It is evaluated across six simulated hands and real Sharpa tool manipulation and Allegro cube reorientation.
papers.tldr_zh: 在策略与轨迹搜索中加入由人手动作提取的相关探索噪声，同时保留完整关节动作空间。验证覆盖六种仿真手，以及Sharpa工具操作和Allegro方块重定向实机策略。
sensing: Vision-based cube pose estimation in real-world DeXtreme
papers.evaluation: Six hand embodiments in simulation; real Sharpa tool-use and Allegro cube-reorientation policies
papers.notes_zh: 六种手并非全部实机测试。人手先验作用于训练探索；没有据接触奖励添加触觉标签。

papers.title: From Wearable Interfaces to Dexterous Policies: Contact Shifts and Tactile Representations
papers.tldr: This study links wearable-interface geometry and tactile representation to demonstration quality and learned dexterous policies. A 20-person study and four real XHand tasks compare interface revisions and binary versus spatial-plus-force tactile inputs.
papers.tldr_zh: 研究可穿戴界面几何和触觉表示如何影响示教及灵巧策略。通过20人研究和四个XHand实机任务，对比界面改版及二值接触与空间加力输入。
sensing: Hall-effect tactile arrays: contact map and aggregate fingertip force
papers.evaluation: Twenty-person interface study; autonomous real-robot policies on four tasks with 20 rollouts per condition
papers.notes_zh: 策略以腕图像和触觉为输入，无本体观测；每条件仅一份训练策略，未隔离空间与力特征各自贡献。

papers.title: ExoBridge: Learning a Bare Hand to Hand-Worn Exoskeleton Mapping through Human Limb Coupling
papers.tldr: ExoBridge learns bare-hand RGB-to-exoskeleton contact, tactile intensity and relative motion from paired bimanual demonstrations. Evaluation uses 1,215 human demonstrations across four tasks with session-separated testing; the predicted states are not evaluated in closed-loop robot control.
papers.tldr_zh: 用双手协同示教，将裸手 RGB 映射到另一只手外骨骼的接触、触觉强度和相对编码器状态。在四项任务的 1,215 段人体示教上按采集会话分离评测；预测状态尚未进入机器人闭环。
sensing: Contralateral exoskeleton tactile arrays and encoders as training targets
papers.evaluation: Offline prediction on human demonstrations; companion robot rollouts use direct exoskeleton demonstrations
papers.notes_zh: 配套 XHand 实机实验直接使用外骨骼示教，不使用 ExoBridge 预测。触觉是人体外骨骼训练目标，推理仅用 RGB，不添加运行时触觉标签。

papers.title: FingerEye: Learning Dexterous Manipulation with Continuous Vision-Tactile Sensing
papers.tldr: FingerEye combines binocular fingertip cameras, a compliant contact ring and grouped policy fusion, evaluated in three simulated and four physical task settings. A separate delicate-grasp controller uses measured deformation thresholds; the main learned policies use RGB and proprioception without explicit plate-pose or wrench inputs.
papers.tldr_zh: FingerEye 以双目指尖相机和柔顺环支持接近观察及接触形变感知，配合分组融合学习策略，在三项仿真与四项实机设置评测。另用实测形变阈值控制易碎物抓取；主学习策略不读取显式位姿或力旋量。
sensing: Measured fingertip plate deformation in delicate-grasp control
papers.evaluation: Three simulated and four real task settings; separate physical delicate-grasp control
papers.notes_zh: 主学习策略不输入显式板位姿或估计力旋量；实机触觉标签限于读取 AprilTag 测得形变的抓取停止控制。显式 FT 学习策略消融只在仿真中进行。

papers.title: DexPIE: Stable Dexterous Policy Improvement from Real-World Experience
papers.tldr: DexPIE combines human intervention, staged DAgger and improved training–inference consistency for reliable value estimation, then conditions a diffusion policy on continuous optimality. One post-training round is evaluated on three physical UR5–Inspire tasks with 50 trials per task.
papers.tldr_zh: 以人工干预和分阶段 DAgger 收集真实执行经验，通过训练推理一致性改善价值估计，再用连续最优性条件化扩散策略。UR5 与 Inspire 手在三项实机任务中完成一次后训练后的独立评测。
papers.evaluation: Physical UR5–Inspire setup; three tasks, 50 independent trials per task after one post-training iteration
papers.notes_zh: 采用实机执行和人工干预数据，未据接触丰富任务添加触觉标签。正式论文称代码和数据将发布，现已核验学习代码仓库与配套遥操作仓库；未核验独立数据下载。

papers.title: Fast Planning for Multi-object Multi-target Throwing
papers.tldr: An offline release-feasibility model and velocity dictionary support fast matching and pruned greedy coordination for multi-object throwing. Simulation scales to four objects; Kuka iiwa 7 with Allegro validates two-object throws using manually preset grasps and calibrated release delay.
papers.tldr_zh: 通过离线可达释放状态与速度字典、在线匹配和剪枝贪心协调，规划多物体向多目标连续投掷。仿真扩展至四物体，Allegro 与 Kuka iiwa 7 实机验证双物体；抓取配置人工预设，释放延迟提前标定。
papers.evaluation: Simulation with two to four objects; physical two-object throws and reactive target changes
papers.notes_zh: 多物体抓取配置人工调整，非抓取合成。ATI nano F/T 用于预先测量释放延迟，未作为运行时触觉输入；实机两种规划方案均命中 14/20 次。

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
papers.tldr: LAC-WM learns shared latent actions from human and robot data, adapts through an action projector, and ranks VLA action candidates by predicted goal proximity. Evaluation covers simulated Franka–Allegro pick-and-place in RoboCasa and modified LIBERO, without reported physical closed-loop deployment.
papers.tldr_zh: 从人类与机器人数据学习统一潜在动作，并以动作投影器适配新本体，用世界模型预测结果筛选 VLA 候选动作。在 RoboCasa 的 Franka–Allegro 抓放及改造 LIBERO 仿真中评测，未报告实机闭环部署。
sensing: Robot state in the VLA candidate generator
papers.evaluation: RoboCasa Franka–Allegro simulation and modified LIBERO simulation
papers.notes_zh: BFA 平台虽有双臂，实验数据和动作只用右臂，不标双手协作。世界模型负责预测和动作筛选，不能由标题推出 Foundation policy；未报告触觉输入或实机闭环。

papers.title: TACROSS: An Efficient and Low-Cost Scalable Human Touch System Across Heterogeneous Tactile Sensors for Dexterous Robot Learning
papers.tldr: TACROSS aligns human-glove and robot touch through contact semantics, sensor adapters and a shared temporal encoder. Robot-supervised ACT uses tactile, visual and proprioceptive inputs during four real-world tasks; human demonstrations supplement representation learning and auxiliary hand targets.
papers.tldr_zh: 将人类手套与机器人触觉映射为共享接触表征，以机器人动作为主要监督训练 ACT。真实 Revo2 在四项任务中使用触觉、视觉和本体状态闭环执行，人类数据辅助表征学习及手部目标监督。
papers.evaluation: Four closed-loop real-robot tasks with Revo2; human and robot tactile data collection.
papers.notes_zh: 人类压阻手套用于采集；执行读取 Revo2 电容触觉。论文同时列出单自由度开合及六通道手部控制接口，不能将所有实验解读为全关节灵巧操作。项目页的代码、硬件与数据下载仍为计划发布。

papers.title: SkillWeave: Weaving Heterogeneous Demonstrations into Long-Horizon Manipulation Skills
papers.tldr: SkillWeave combines teleoperation and kinesthetic demonstrations, object-mask-conditioned diffusion policies and successor-aware handoff steering. On a LEAP hand, three real-world multi-stage tasks achieve 27% average end-to-end success using RGB and proprioception.
papers.tldr_zh: 按子任务结合遥操作和动觉示教，以物体掩码条件扩散策略处理示教遮挡，再引导前一策略接近后一策略的起始状态。LEAP 实机三项多阶段任务平均端到端成功率为 27%，运行输入为 RGB 和本体状态。
papers.evaluation: Three autonomous real-world tasks on xArm7 plus 16-DoF LEAP; 20 trials per reported policy/task setting.
papers.notes_zh: 方法 IV-A 的策略观测仅为两路 RGB 与本体状态，不标触觉反馈。SAM 3 只生成训练掩码，部署使用学习到的掩码预测器；项目页代码仍标 Coming Soon。

papers.title: Generative Neural Retargeting for Human-to-Robot Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: GNR learns flow-matching corrections to IK references from MPC-generated examples, then samples feasible dexterous trajectories or initializes MPC. Simulation studies cover HOT3D retargeting and precision assembly, producing 223k paired demonstrations with simulated contact-force annotations.
papers.tldr_zh: 从 MPC 生成的样本学习流匹配残差，修正 IK 参考轨迹，并以采样或 MPC 初始化加速灵巧重定向。在仿真中评测 HOT3D 和精密装配，生成约 22.3 万组带仿真接触力标签的人机配对示教。
sensing: Human hand motion, object pose and mesh as retargeting inputs
papers.evaluation: SuperDex simulation: HOT3D, ShapeFilter and NIST retargeting; DG-5F, with Franka FR3 for assembly.
papers.notes_zh: 所读评测是仿真轨迹生成、回放及仿真闭环 MPC，不声称实机自主部署。接触力从仿真导出，未据此添加 Tactile feedback；项目页未给出代码下载。

papers.title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control
papers.tldr: Success Guided Sampling reallocates PPO resets toward configurations with moderate success rates. Scaling studies span quadruped locomotion and parallel-gripper assembly; RGB students distilled from simulation teachers transfer zero-shot to three UR5e assembly tasks.
papers.tldr_zh: 以在线成功率调整 PPO 的重置采样，使训练更多覆盖当前可学习的任务配置。扩展实验涵盖四足运动与平行夹爪装配，并将仿真教师蒸馏为 RGB 学生，在 UR5e 上零样本完成三类装配评测。
sensing: Side and wrist RGB for deployed student
Arm joint positions, end-effector pose and previous action
papers.evaluation: Large-scale locomotion and gripper-assembly simulation; RGB closed-loop UR5e transfer on three real assembly tasks.
papers.notes_zh: 作为通用训练算法相邻收录；SGS 改变训练配置采样，而非提供新的多指手控制器或 PPO 损失。真实装配平台为 UR5e 加 Robotiq 2F-85；无运行触觉依据。项目页代码尚未发布。

papers.title: Dex-One2Many: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Demonstration
papers.tldr: Dex-One2Many converts one human video into stage-wise scene graphs that define RL observations, rewards and diverse resets. Policies trained in simulation transfer zero-shot to a Wuji 1 hand for five manipulation and tool-use tasks; cross-embodiment tests remain simulated.
papers.tldr_zh: 把单段人类视频抽象为分阶段场景图，用于构造观测、奖励和多样重置状态。策略在仿真训练后零样本部署到 Wuji 1，评测五项操作与工具任务；四手型比较在仿真中进行。
papers.evaluation: Five tasks in simulation and on UR3 plus Wuji 1; four arm-hand embodiments evaluated in simulation.
papers.notes_zh: 真实实验仅 UR3 加 20 自由度 Wuji 1，其余手型为仿真比较。视觉位姿和本体状态进入部署观测；接触力闭合用于奖励，不能标记运行触觉。项目页代码仍为 Coming soon。

papers.title: Human2Dex: Dexterous Robot Learning from Wrist-Centric Human Demonstrations
papers.tldr: Human2Dex converts wrist-centric human demonstrations into hand-specific training data using structural visual alignment, retargeting and grasp-relative object geometry. Separate diffusion policies achieve 109/120 and 97/120 successes on Linker O6 and Wuji across six real-world tasks with observation-based replanning.
papers.tldr_zh: 将腕部视角人类示教经视觉结构对齐、重定向和抓取相对几何转换为各手专用数据。独立扩散策略在 Linker O6 与 Wuji 上闭环完成六项实机任务，成功数分别为 109/120 和 97/120。
papers.evaluation: Real-world closed-loop trials on two five-finger hands and six tasks; 20 trials per hand-task pair, with separate policies for each pair.
papers.notes_zh: 正文评测为实机闭环，离线步骤用于转换人类示教；未报告仿真评测或仅动作回放的结果。跨本体指示教复用，两手的动作、归一化与策略分别训练，不能视为统一基座策略。视觉预训练与几何交互信息不构成运行时触觉。

papers.title: Beyond Actions: Learning Future Operation Targets for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.tldr: AFCE learns executable Effect targets from demonstrated actions, robot responses and future visual changes. A flow-matching VLA predicts these targets from current observations and decodes action chunks. On 11 simulated Panda–Allegro tasks, closed-loop success reaches 50.97%, with gains concentrated in bimanual tasks; reconstruction and ground-truth-Effect replay are separate training-data diagnostics.
papers.tldr_zh: AFCE 将示教动作、机器人响应与未来视觉变化编码为可解码的 Effect，再由流匹配 VLA 从当前观测预测并执行。在 11 项 Panda–Allegro 仿真任务中闭环成功率为 50.97%，收益主要来自双臂任务；训练集重建与回放另作诊断。
papers.evaluation: Simulation
papers.notes_zh: 评测限于仿真，未报告实机。单臂精细控制并非全面提升；共享单臂/双臂接口不证明跨本体不变性。

papers.title: AutoBio+: Benchmarking Dexterous Manipulation with Dynamic Experimental Phenomena in Realistic Laboratories
papers.tldr: AutoBio+ benchmarks laboratory manipulation with articulated hands using parallel scripted demonstrations, Gaussian-splatting backgrounds, and dynamic visual effects. Four policies are compared on 12 simulated tasks; a separate UR5e–XHand tube-transfer experiment tests the effect of simulated backgrounds on real-robot performance.
papers.tldr_zh: 面向实验室灵巧操作，结合并行脚本示教、Gaussian Splatting 背景和动态视觉粒子构建基准。四种策略在 12 项仿真任务上比较，另以 UR5e–XHand 转移试管验证仿真背景对实机表现的影响。
papers.evaluation: Simulation + real robot
papers.notes_zh: 共 14 项任务、4 种本体；仿真评测覆盖其中 12 项，实机范围限于 UR5e–XHand 试管转移。手指自由度数未确认。V-B 与附录 E 对实机训练数据组成表述不一致，暂不据此概括迁移设置。未复现实验。

papers.title: METIS: Multi-Source Egocentric Training for Integrated Dexterous Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.tldr: METIS pretrains a VLA on unified human and robot egocentric trajectories using compact visual and motion dynamics tokens, then fine-tunes it for dexterous tasks. Real-world evaluation covers eight tasks on G1 with Inspire hands and three transfer tasks on SharpaWave hands, with vision and proprioception as execution inputs.
papers.tldr_zh: 将人类与机器人第一视角轨迹统一为腕部和指尖动作，以紧凑的视觉及运动动力学 token 预训练 VLA，再微调用于灵巧操作。实机评测覆盖 G1/Inspire 的八项任务及 SharpaWave 的三项迁移任务，执行输入为视觉与本体状态。
papers.evaluation: Real-world G1/Inspire evaluation on six primary and two tool-use tasks, with additional three-task SharpaWave transfer evaluation; standard task evaluation uses 20 trials.
papers.notes_zh: 使用统一人机动作空间与大规模多源预训练支持基座策略标签；部署经过下游微调。只总结论文实机结果，未进行代码复现。项目页和正文存在任务计数新旧差异，以已核验 v2 正文为准；无触觉反馈标签。

papers.title: SiMDex: Mining Similar Egocentric Videos for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: SiMDex mines human motion samples for dexterous VLA post-training through language, pose and action similarity; optical flow audits the selection. In three real-world bimanual tasks, mining 1.49M samples from a 32M pool raises mean normalized partial-progress scores from 47.7% to 61.7% over equal-size random sampling, with human subtask instruction switching.
papers.tldr_zh: 按语言、手形及动作相似性挖掘人类样本用于灵巧 VLA 后训练，光流仅作检索核验。在三项双手实机任务中，从约 3200 万样本选出 149 万条，相比等量随机样本使平均归一化部分进度得分从 47.7% 提至 61.7%；子任务指令由人员切换。
papers.evaluation: Real-world two-arm, two-hand platform; three tasks with ten trials each for each method, using two repetitions of five layouts. Results are normalized partial-progress scores, averaged across tasks; data-scaling ablations use five trials per task.
papers.notes_zh: 论文明确省略机器人/手型号，因此 hand 留空。Cross-embodiment 指人类数据向机器人迁移，不表示已跨多种机器人手验证；运行输入未包含触觉。光流重排未改变训练集合。人员切换子任务指令；报告的 SR 含部分步骤得分，不能写成最终完整成功率。本文沿用已有基座，故不赋 Foundation policy 标签；未执行代码或验证复现。

papers.title: When Does Touch Matter? Charting the Vision-Interaction Gap in Cluttered Dexterous Grasping
papers.tldr: A controlled real-world study compares vision, estimated wrenches and fingertip taxels for cluttered grasping on a LEAP hand. With shared demonstrations and compliant control, the fused diffusion policy succeeds in 24/25 episodes versus 14/25 for vision only across five conditions; each episode allows repeated grasp attempts.
papers.tldr_zh: 在 LEAP 实机上受控比较视觉、估算 wrench 与指尖触觉对拥挤抓取的作用。固定示教数据和柔顺控制后，融合扩散策略在五种条件下成功 24/25 次，视觉策略为 14/25；每次任务允许多次自主重抓。
sensing: Current/Jacobian-based fingertip and wrist wrench estimates
papers.evaluation: 200 physical trials across eight controlled policy variants, five conditions and five trials per combination on xArm7 with LEAP; no simulation evaluation is reported.
papers.notes_zh: 触觉反馈来自机器人指尖真实测量；wrench 来自电机电流和运动学估算。视觉基线仍使用共享的 wrench 柔顺控制，不能称其整套系统完全无交互反馈。样本限于单手、单硬件类别与五种布置；未验证复现。

papers.title: Learning tactile perception from high-bandwidth single-point sensing
papers.tldr: SpectRobot converts single-point, high-bandwidth tactile vibrations into spectrogram observations for ACT. Real SO-101 gripper experiments sort opaque boxes by hidden contents and compare seven sensor types and spectrogram settings. Longer-context representations improve sorting, while benefits above 10 kHz remain unresolved in this task.
papers.tldr_zh: SpectRobot 将单点高带宽触觉振动转换为 ACT 可用的频谱观测。在 SO-101 夹爪实机上按不透明盒内部物体分拣，比较七种传感技术与频谱配置；较长时间范围显著改善表现，但该任务中超过 10 kHz 的收益尚未得到统计区分。
papers.evaluation: Real-world SO-101 experiments only: 40 demonstrations per dataset and 80 autonomous trials per condition, spanning seven sensing technologies, three gripper designs and two acquisition chains.
papers.notes_zh: 使用普通夹爪验证触觉表征，未声称已在多指手上完成灵巧任务；故 scope 为 adjacent。100 kHz 是采集频带而不是策略控制频率。不同配置的时间范围和带宽存在耦合，高性能传感器间置信区间重叠。作者披露其中两人就职于被评测 Dragonfly 传感器制造商；未进行独立复现。

papers.title: VisTacAlign: Co-Training Dexterous Policies on Tactile Human and Robot Demonstrations using Visual-Tactile Alignment
papers.tldr: VisTacAlign aligns human motion, stereo appearance and glove forces with robot demonstrations to co-train a tactile flow policy. A 17-DoF ORCA Hand v2 is evaluated on three real tasks: Lego assembly, strawberry plucking and drill activation/lifting; each task still needs robot contact data.
papers.tldr_zh: 将人类动作、双目外观和手套力信号对齐至机器人示教，联合训练触觉流策略；在17自由度 ORCA Hand v2 的积木装配、草莓采摘和电钻操作三项实机任务验证，每个任务仍需机器人接触数据。

papers.title: HACo: Learning Haptic Active Compliance for Force-Aware Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: HACo learns compliant commands from regulated teleoperation and conditions a flow policy on fingertip touch and joint torques. On a dual-UR5, dual-Sharpa system, five real force-sensitive tasks yield 83% mean success over 20 trials per task, using task-specific training data.
papers.tldr_zh: HACo 从受柔顺调节的遥操作学习可执行指令，并以指尖触觉和关节扭矩条件化流策略；在双 UR5、双 Sharpa 手的五项实机力敏感任务上，每项20次评测，平均成功率83%，使用逐任务训练数据。

papers.title: DexFLEX: Contact-Aware Foundation Controller for Command-Guided Dexterity
papers.tldr: DexFLEX proposes fingertip motions from tactile–proprioceptive state and selects them using predicted contact consequences. Trained on simulated expert rollouts, the frozen controller is reused for command recovery, six real LEAP-hand tool-use tasks and three visuomotor tasks; real teleoperation averages 78.3% success.
papers.tldr_zh: DexFLEX 根据触觉与本体状态提议指尖动作，再按预测接触后果选择执行；从仿真专家数据训练的冻结控制器复用于指令恢复、LEAP手六项实机工具任务和三项视觉策略任务，实机遥操作平均成功率78.3%。
hand: LEAP hand (16 DoF, real and simulation)

papers.title: DexCast: Learning Real-World Dexterous Control from Human Videos
papers.tldr: DexCast reconstructs human hand–object videos, refines trajectories with residual RL and conditions a 3D diffusion policy on a pretrained hand-motion representation. Without robot demonstrations, a UR5 with a 12-DoF XHAND performs six real tasks, averaging 87.5% and 86.7% success across two viewpoints.
papers.tldr_zh: DexCast 从人类手物视频重建轨迹，经残差强化学习精修，再用预训练手部运动表征条件化3D扩散策略；无需机器人示教，在 UR5 与12自由度 XHAND 六项实机任务的两个视角下，平均成功率分别为87.5%和86.7%。

papers.title: Edge-Native Temporal--Graph Dual-Expert Inference for Dexterous Grasp Classification
papers.tldr: A temporal expert and finger-graph expert classify objects from RH56 joint angles and actuator-load proxies, while only the temporal expert controls finger stopping on an embedded board. Evaluation covers five object instances, 1,500 recorded trajectories and 50 real grasps, with 49 successful lift-and-hold trials.
papers.tldr_zh: 在 RH56 上以关节角和执行器负载代理驱动时序—手指图双专家分类，仅由时序专家控制板端逐指停止；评测覆盖五个物体实例、1500条轨迹及50次实机抓取，49次通过提起保持测试。

papers.title: Hand2Robot: Object-Centric 4D Hand Reconstruction from Human Demonstrations for Robotics
papers.tldr: Hand2Robot reconstructs object-referenced hand motion from RGB-D human demonstrations and retargets it to supplement robot data for policy post-training. Reconstruction is evaluated on DexYCB and HO3D-v3; on three Franka–xHand tasks, mixed human/robot training raises mean real-robot success from 48.3% to 80%.
papers.tldr_zh: 从 RGB-D 人类示教重建物体约束的手部运动，重定向后补充机器人数据用于策略后训练。在 DexYCB、HO3D-v3 评测重建质量；Franka–xHand 三项实机任务中，混合示教的平均成功率由仅机器人数据的 48.3% 提升至 80%。
papers.notes_zh: 主要方法为交互重建，按 Hand–Object Interaction 分类；真实机器人用途明确，scope 为 core。采用预训练 π0.5 做目标任务后训练，未把此数据处理框架标成新的基座策略。项目地址访问返回404，未收录。
papers.evaluation: Offline human–object reconstruction benchmarks and three real-robot target-task policy evaluations; 20 trials per task, with initial positions sampled from the training distribution.

papers.title: DeTac: Dual-branch Decoupling of Texture and Force Signals in Vision-Based Tactile Sensors
papers.tldr: DeTac separates shading and marker signals in optical tactile images using parallel diffusion-restoration and marker-extraction branches with joint losses and paired physical data. Tests cover signal recovery, force estimation, surface reconstruction and robot-mounted fabric classification; no closed-loop manipulation policy is evaluated.
papers.tldr_zh: 以并行扩散恢复与标记提取分支、交叉监督及真实配对数据，解耦光学触觉图像中的纹理和力信息。评测涵盖信号恢复、力估计、表面重建及机械臂触压织物分类，未评测闭环操作策略。
sensing: Six-axis force sensor for evaluation ground truth
papers.notes_zh: 触觉图像实际进入感知模型，但未证明进入操作控制器，故不添加 Tactile feedback。扩散模型生成触觉图像而非动作，故不添加 Diffusion / flow policy；不推测多指手型号。
papers.evaluation: Physical tactile-image data and robot-mounted sensing experiments; no dexterous-hand manipulation policy evaluation.

papers.title: Force-Modulated Dexterity: Unified Compliance for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.tldr: FOMO-Dex uses task/contact directions to turn measured forces into selected arm or finger command corrections. Real Sharpa Wave experiments cover four contact-rich tasks and demonstration collection; diffusion policies learn from corrected actions. The best card policy uses force observations with a stiff execution controller.
papers.tldr_zh: 沿任务与接触方向，将测得的力转为选择性的手臂或手指命令修正。Sharpa Wave 实机评测四项接触任务及示教采集，再训练模仿修正动作的扩散策略；最佳取卡策略读取力观测，但推理执行采用刚性控制器。
papers.notes_zh: 力调制器按任务设定方向与力目标；并非统一基座策略。自主策略读取力观测，不应据Comp.Applied推理使用刚性控制而误判为无触觉，也不应宣称所有学习策略部署都有外层力调制。
papers.evaluation: Real-robot teleoperation on four tasks, operator study, and behavior-cloning evaluation on card picking and two rotational tasks; no simulation success rates substituted for hardware results.

papers.title: DexNinja: Learning Robust Dexterous Cutting Policy with a Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Engine
papers.tldr: DexNinja expands teleoperated food-cutting demonstrations with reconstructed assets and deformable tactile simulation, then trains an ACT-style arm/hand policy. Real visual–tactile deployment achieves 50% cutting success across four food categories versus 31% from real-only data; a second embodiment is demonstrated qualitatively.
papers.tldr_zh: 将遥操作食材切割示教经物体重建和可变形触觉仿真扩充，训练分离手臂与手部动作的 ACT 策略。真实视触觉部署在四类食材上取得50%切割成功率，仅真实示教为31%；第二种机器人构型提供定性验证。
sensing: Pressure-based tactile sensors on both hands
method: ACT-style policy with stage-conditioned action chunks
papers.notes_zh: 区分主实验50%与扩展实验63%，以及主平台定量评测和第二构型定性展示。ACT动作分块不等于扩散策略；可微仿真不意味着部署时使用仿真接触代替真实触觉。
papers.evaluation: Simulation data generation followed by 300 real trials across three data regimes (100 per regime), plus scaling/ablation studies; second robot embodiment is qualitative.

papers.title: EgoCPT: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Ego-Centric Video with Contact-Aware Optimization
papers.tldr: EgoCPT searches contacts, refines robot poses and allocates feasible forces while preserving object motion from human demonstrations, then learns a bimanual residual policy in simulation. EgoDex/TACO reconstruction evaluations and simulated execution ablations support the method; real Sharpa demonstrations replay the learned trajectories.
papers.tldr_zh: 保持人类示教的物体运动目标，搜索接触、细化机器人姿态并分配可行力，再于仿真训练双手残差策略。EgoDex/TACO重建序列评测与仿真执行消融提供验证；Sharpa实机演示直接回放所学轨迹。
sensing: Object poses and reference targets in simulation
papers.notes_zh: 双手仿真闭环与实机轨迹回放必须分开；未报告实机闭环成功率，也未提供真实机器人触觉进入策略的证据。力分配是参考构建步骤，不标Force control或Tactile feedback。
papers.evaluation: Reconstruction acceptance on 52 EgoDex and 25 TACO sequences, simulated residual-RL execution ablations, and real bimanual Sharpa trajectory playback demonstrations.

papers.title: PACT: Posture-Aligned Co-Design Technique for Hand Configuration and Retargeting in Multi-Finger Imitation Learning
papers.tldr: PACT jointly optimizes a four-digit, 17-servo hand and its deployed posture retargeter under fabrication constraints. Kinematic pose tests and physical grasping validate the design: 43/50 everyday-object grasps succeed, and an illustrative ACT can-placement policy succeeds in 9/12 held-out placements without tactile sensing.
papers.tldr_zh: 在可制造约束下联合优化四指17舵机手与实际部署的姿态重定向器。运动学姿态测试和实机抓取验证设计：日常物体抓取43/50成功；作为用途演示的ACT罐子放置策略在未见摆放位置成功9/12，未使用触觉传感。
sensing: Single RGB camera for human pose estimation
papers.notes_zh: 主要贡献为硬件与重定向联合设计，不是新策略优化算法；ACT结果是用途演示。四指布局不含小指，不能称五指手。未见物体运动学评测不等于未知使用者手型泛化。
papers.evaluation: Kinematic posture evaluation plus fabricated-hand grasp/payload/deformation experiments and an illustrative real-robot ACT pick-and-place task.

papers.title: Dex4D: Task-Agnostic Point Track Policy for Zero-Shot Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: Dex4D trains a point-track-conditioned pose controller in simulation, then combines video-generated goals with visual feedback for dexterous manipulation without real-robot finetuning. The LEAP-hand system succeeds in 45/80 trials across four real tasks; its closed loop tracks the manipulated object only.
papers.tldr_zh: Dex4D 在仿真训练点轨迹条件的位姿控制器，以生成视频提供目标、视觉跟踪提供反馈，无实机微调完成灵巧操作。LEAP 系统在四项实机任务中成功 45/80 次；闭环仅追踪被操作物体。
sensing: Arm and hand joint positions and velocities
papers.evaluation: Six simulated tasks, 100 trials each; four physical tasks, 20 trials each, with unseen objects and no real-robot finetuning.
papers.notes_zh: 基础视频模型用于规划，不据此标为 Foundation policy 或 VLA。XHand 结果是训练配方迁移。硬件仓库仍标 Coming Soon；代码链接指向已开放的仿真实现，未验证复现。

papers.title: EgoMatrix: Physically Faithful Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Egocentric Human Videos
papers.tldr: EgoMatrix combines contact-aware monocular reconstruction, retargeting and PPO tracking to generate bimanual robot trajectories and paired images. It transfers 34 of 62 demonstrations successfully in simulation and shows selected XHand hardware replays; downstream policy-training gains remain untested.
papers.tldr_zh: 以接触感知单目重建、重定向和PPO跟踪生成双手机器人轨迹及配对图像；62条示教中34条在仿真转移成功，并展示部分XHand实机回放，尚未验证下游策略训练收益。

papers.title: EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ
papers.tldr: EgoExplorer couples wearable capture with calibrated motion reconstruction to collect 100 hours of human locomotion and manipulation, including hand articulation and partial tactile coverage. Evaluation concerns annotation quality, offline multimodal modeling, and two G1 simulation clips with kinematic finger replay; real-robot manipulation is untested.
papers.tldr_zh: 以穿戴采集和经标定的运动重建记录100小时人类移动与操作，包含手指姿态及部分触觉覆盖。验证涵盖标注质量、离线多模态建模和两段G1仿真运动跟踪，手指仅运动学回放，尚未验证实机操作。
task: Human laboratory and household manipulation capture
papers.notes_zh: 按人手交互数据贡献归为相邻资源；不标Tactile feedback或Force control。身体误差不是独立真值精度，手姿恢复率不是机器人任务成功率。所审v1写三指手；项目页另示五指Wuji，未据此改写正文实验。100小时为采集规模，当前公开入口仅提供需申请的66分钟迷你版；代码尚未发布。
papers.evaluation: Controlled human capture tests, natural-recording consistency, offline multimodal studies, and two training-clip humanoid simulations; no hardware deployment or unseen-task validation.

papers.title: FoLD: Force-Informed Learning for Dexterous Articulated Object Manipulation
papers.tldr: FoLD encodes virtual corrective force fields to guide residual reinforcement learning from human articulated-object demonstrations. Across 27 paired simulation cases, mean trajectory completion rises from 0.606 to 0.772; hardware demonstrations replay generated motions without online policy inference.
papers.tldr_zh: FoLD 将虚拟补偿力场编码为残差强化学习输入，把人类示教转为双手铰接物体操作。27 对仿真评测的平均轨迹完成比例由 0.606 提至 0.772；实机仅开环回放生成动作，无在线策略推理。
sensing: Geometric contact regions for virtual force allocation
task: Headphone folding and laptop closing (physical replay)
Scissor opening and closing (Galbot physical replay)
method: PPO residual policy with a frozen hand-motion imitator
papers.evaluation: Seven ARCTIC clips across four hands, with 27 paired cases after one paired exclusion; additional five-sequence CHORD comparison. Physical demonstrations are qualitative open-loop replay.
papers.notes_zh: SR 是连续轨迹完成比例，不能解释为任务二值成功率。不同手/任务分别训练；仿真评测关闭虚拟物体辅助，未报告独立训练种子统计。虚拟力指导不等于触觉反馈；实机不是闭环策略迁移。已核验项目页，尚未提供公开代码链接。

papers.title: DexMimic: A Generalist Dexterous Hand-Object Tracking Policy via Value-Guided Reset Allocation
papers.tldr: DexMimic uses critic-guided reset phases and states to jointly train a reference-conditioned dexterous tracking policy. It reaches 88.40% success on 50 bimanual simulation tasks and studies adaptation and unseen-object transfer; physical execution replays successful simulation trajectories.
papers.tldr_zh: DexMimic 以价值估计分配重置阶段和状态，联合训练参考条件的灵巧跟踪策略。在 50 项双手仿真任务上成功率达 88.40%，并评测微调及未见物体泛化；实机执行为成功仿真轨迹的开环回放。
sensing: Simulated hand and object states with fingertip contact forces
RealSense D435i RGB-D for initial object pose estimation only
task: Single-hand and bimanual hand-object trajectory tracking
Pouring, scooping, tilting and shaking (physical replay)
method: Joint training across human interaction trajectories
papers.evaluation: Benchmark contains 1,944 trajectories over 140 rigid objects from OakInk-V2 and HOT3D. Main comparison uses 50 bimanual tasks with 50 rollouts each; separate fine-tuning, zero-shot transfer and four-hand studies. Hardware demonstrations use open-loop replay.
papers.notes_zh: 50 项主评测的训练耗时按联合训练总耗时除以轨迹数计算；跟踪误差仅在成功回合上汇总。四种手分别训练策略，不能据此称同一策略零样本跨手部署。仿真接触力不构成实机触觉反馈；项目页未提供代码链接。

papers.title: FACT: A Multimodal Force-Action-Track Foundation Model for Human-to-Robot Dexterity
papers.tldr: FACT pretrains a control policy on human and robot demonstrations, combining visual-track planning with tactile action refinement. After separate fine-tuning for each of ten real-robot tasks, it reaches 41.4% mean success on the seven binary tasks; the other three use task-specific scores.
papers.tldr_zh: FACT 联合人机示教预训练控制策略，以视觉轨迹规划和触觉动作精修实现灵巧操作。十项实机任务分别微调后，七项二值任务平均成功率为 41.4%，另三项使用各自评分。
papers.evaluation: Ten real-robot tasks, ten rollouts each, with separate task-specific fine-tuning and randomized object placement.
papers.notes_zh: 基础策略经任务分别微调；未展示同一策略零样本完成全部任务。人类预训练的手套压力不能直接观测切向力。代码和数据尚未发布。

papers.title: HiFun: a Hierarchical Framework for Efficient Functional Dexterous Manipulation Learning
papers.tldr: HiFun learns tactile hand skills with residual RL, then coordinates arm motion and skill activation using DMP initialization and human corrections. It reports 295/300 successes across six real tasks on Sharpa and XHand. The one-hour budget covers online coordination training, not the full pipeline.
papers.tldr_zh: HiFun 以残差强化学习训练触觉手技能，再通过 DMP 初始化和人工纠正学习手臂运动及技能激活。在 Sharpa 与 XHand 的六项实机任务中成功 295/300 次；一小时预算仅覆盖在线协调训练。
method: Frozen hand skills and arm-hand coordination
Multi-head critic and intervention advantage weighting
papers.evaluation: Six physical tasks with 50 main trials each; 20 perturbation trials per task; primary evaluation randomizes poses inside the trained workspace.
papers.notes_zh: 两种手展示训练框架的适用性，不代表同一策略零样本跨手迁移。基线评分含少数半分；代码仓库目前为发布占位。

papers.title: RoboSpan: Learning Modular Coordination Policies for High-DoF Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation with Teleoperation
papers.tldr: RoboSpan combines tactile dexterous hands with whole-body teleoperation. HMF uses stage-specific behavior cloning and cross-module attention for hand, arm and base coordination. It reports 54.7% mean success on three physical whole-body tasks; the policy description still includes operator foot-IMU intent.
papers.tldr_zh: RoboSpan 将触觉多指手集成到全身遥操作平台，HMF 通过分阶段行为克隆与跨模块注意力协调手、臂和底盘。三项实机全身任务平均成功率为 54.7%；策略观测仍列有操作者脚部 IMU 意图。
papers.evaluation: Physical 29-DoF platform; three whole-body tasks, three tactile-ablation tasks and teleoperation comparisons. Trial counts are not specified in the inspected text.
papers.notes_zh: 未核验到项目或代码地址。缺试验次数及清楚的无人工输入部署说明；不宣称完全自主。VLM 用于阶段分解，未据此标为 Foundation policy 或 VLA。表 IV 的完整方法标作 COMET，正文称 HMF。

papers.title: Coordi-pi: Coordination-Aware Dual-Hand Action Representation for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: Coordi-pi interleaves left/right arm–hand action tokens and adds hand identity and factorized temporal encoding to a flow-based VLA. It improves five simulated bimanual tasks and achieves 60/80 successes on four real tasks with Revo 2 hands, versus 49/80 for pi0.5.
